---
title: "Literal &amp;nbsp; and &notanentity; and R&notebook and &#123"
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
citation: true
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_title"][content="Literal &nbsp; and &notanentity; and R&notebook and &#123"]']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-appendix-citeas']
        matches: ['“Literal &Nbsp; and &Notanentity; and\s+R&notebook and &#123\.”']
        noMatches: [" "]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # BibTeX title; R\&notebook must not have its legacy &not decoded to ¬
        - ['title = \{Literal \\&amp;Nbsp; and \\&amp;Notanentity; and', 'R\\&amp;notebook', '\\&amp;\\#123\}']
        - ['R\\¬ebook']
---

Text that only looks like an HTML entity stays literal in the appendix citation, the BibTeX citation and the Google Scholar metadata: an escaped `&amp;nbsp;` is the text `&nbsp;`, not a no-break space, and an unknown entity or an incomplete reference is not decoded.
